coordinate.coordinate_system: NASA PGDA south-polar stereographic X/Y pixel-center coordinates, metres; not latitude/longitude

scientific_interpretation: At the selected Site01 reference point and epoch, the idealized lunar horizon is illuminated, but local terrain obstructs direct sunlight.
child_friendly_explanation: Even though the Sun is above the Moon's horizon, a nearby ridge can block its light from reaching this location.
required_limitation: The analysis demonstrates sunlight obstruction, not a measured electrical power reduction.
limitations: This fixture reconstructs the frozen scientific explanation without requesting live NASA data.
The expected result is team-derived and not NASA-approved.
The three tested clones are not a complete 100-clone uncertainty analysis.
The referenced 15-minute time series contains sampled timestamps, not exact continuous shadow boundaries.
No electrical power, watts, watt-hours, battery capacity, or power-loss percentage is represented.
replay_scope: Deterministic snapshot and interpretation replay only; not a full scientific calculation recomputation.
